title: SDK Concierge Mini-Ops Cookbook
content:
Purpose
This is a compact, pragmatic runbook to act as the "concierge" for a new SDK adopter. Focus: make first integration 15–45 min, capture the telemetry we need, and provide tiny ops patterns that avoid a flood of support tickets.

Audience
- SDK team engineers + solutions architects
- SEs doing first-calls / POCs
- On-call triage engineers (first 48 hours)

Why this doc exists (tl;dr)
- Small checklist + config presets for getting a PoC into traffic quickly
- Telemetry and gating to detect prompt regressions early
- Playbook snippets for common failure modes and automatic fallbacks

Quickstart (15–45 min path)
1) Create API key (console) and env: REDWOOD_API_KEY = <key>
2) Install minimal SDK (node example): npm install @redwood/sdk --save
3) Wire a single endpoint: generate text, set model=redwood-medium, timeout=6s, streaming off
4) Run 10 warmup requests using provided prompt-suite (warmup-prompts.txt) to prime caches and measure cold start
5) Toggle telemetry flag to send sample events (see Telemetry section)

Minimal sample - curl (copyable)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"Summarize: Explain the two-phase commit in one paragraph."}'

Node snippet (pseudo)
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, timeoutMs: 6000 });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', input: 'Explain X' });
console.log(res.text);

Concierge checklist (pre-demo)
- [ ] Create dedicated project in console (add billing contact)
- [ ] Reserve a model variant for demo (pin version)
- [ ] Upload 6–10 test prompts (happy path + edge cases)
- [ ] Enable sample telemetry and dev flags
- [ ] Share single-threaded guide with customer: sample curl + node snippet + retry guidance

Ops mini-recipes (if demo goes live)
- Autoscaling suggestion: start with concurrency=8, max-burst=32, monitor CPU/GPU util 15-min window
- Batching profile: set batching.target_ms=25 for chat flows under 1s average latency; 50ms for heavy-generation
- Fallback: add model alias chain: redwood-small -> redwood-medium -> redwood-large (large last for quality)
- If p50 latency spikes > 2x baseline: enable prefix-cache (30s TTL) for repeated prompts and reduce batching.window_ms by 10

Telemetry contract (events + properties) - template
We need simple, actionable telemetry to spot: cold starts, prompt regression, prompt truncation, and fallback events. Keep payloads tiny.
Required events (names are canonical):
- sdk.request_start {request_id, route, model, user_id, client_version, sequence_length} 
- sdk.request_end {request_id, route, model, status, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out} 
- sdk.fallback_triggered {request_id, from_model, to_model, reason_code} 
- sdk.kv_cache_hit {request_id, percent_cached} 
- sdk.prompt_alert {request_id, test_id, eval_name, score_delta}

Suggested sample fields (string/number enums only):
- reason_code: COLD_START | CAPACITY | ERROR | POLICY_FALLBACK
- status: OK | ERROR | TIMED_OUT

Telemetry sampling guidance
- Sandbox: 100% events for first 48h then 10% after
- Production: sample at 1% for request_start/end; 100% for fallback_triggered and prompt_alert

Small templates (copyable)
console telemetry flag: "telemetry.write.enabled=true"
Jira template for regressions: title="Prompt regression: <eval_name> dropped by >10%" body="See test-suite <link>, sample inputs, and slack thread #prod-alerts"

Common failure modes and quick fixes
- Error: "429 rate limit" -> Quick fix: recommend client-side exponential backoff up to 8s, surface per-route quota via /quota API and suggest dedicated capacity option if >50 rps sustained.
- High latency variance (>50% p95/p50) -> Quick fix: check batching.window_ms, disable cross-request batching for low-latency routes, enable prefix cache for repeats.
- Output truncation -> Check max_tokens setting on request, and the runtime’s sequence_length param; recommend increase limit or switch to streaming when large responses needed.
- Poor quality after model update -> Rollback to pinned model version, run regression suite (see linked artifacts), alert SE and model-ops.

Playloop - rapid iteration protocol (for SDK team + customer)
1) Make a small prompt change locally; run eval locally against 20 prompts
2) Push flagged change behind feature-flag route to 1% traffic for 4 hours
3) Observe sdk.prompt_alert and traffic telemetry; if delta < threshold, increase to 10% for 24 hours
4) If issues, rollback automatically and create postmortem with checklist

Chef-style presets (tiny config files customers can copy)
1) minimal.json - for low-cost demos
{
  "model": "redwood-small",
  "timeoutMs": 4000,
  "batching": {"enabled": false},
  "telemetry": {"sample_rate": 1.0}
}
2) latency-first.json - for UI experiences
{
  "model": "redwood-medium",
  "timeoutMs": 2000,
  "batching": {"enabled": true, "target_ms": 25},
  "telemetry": {"sample_rate": 0.1}
}
(These are snippets not strict json files in this doc; paste into the Console config editor.)

Notes to self / unresolved questions
- Should we expose a single 'first-hit warmup' API that runs preset warmups? (ask infra)
- Decide deterministic name for telemetry events (prefix sdk. vs redwood.sdk.)
- Add a tiny library helper for exponential backoff + jitter and publish in samples repo

Hand-off checklist for SE -> SRE after 72 hours live
- [ ] Export full telemetry for last 72h to S3: events, traces, alerts
- [ ] Confirm model pinning and rollout policy in console (canary settings)
- [ ] Create incident playbook with owners and SLA expectations

Where this lives and how to use it
- Keep this doc as the "first-48h concierge" template in the SDK repo; copy into the customer's project Confluence with the three config presets updated.
- Add a note under the demo script for the SE to show the fallback chain if the audience asks about reliability.

Appendix: quick links (copy)
Console: https://console.redwood.ai/projects
Quota API: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/quota
Telemetry schema (proto): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVEXP/Telemetry+Schema
Slack channel for SEs: #se-concierge

End of doc.
